name: rev-wallet-extension
description: Least-authority RChain deploy signing as a Manifest V3 browser extension - a page can request one signature at a time, approved explicitly in the extension popup. Never holds the key outside the background service worker.

scripts.build: vite build --config vite.config.ts && vite build --config vite.config.content-script.ts && vite build --config vite.config.inject.ts
